landing.headline: Accurate Body Measurements from Two Camera Angles
landing.description: Contactless body measurement extraction from orthogonal front and side photographs. Generates a three-dimensional mannequin, recommends ideal garment sizing, and guarantees privacy.
landing.step1Desc: Stand before the camera with a standard ID-1 card or A4 paper to establish millimeter-per-pixel scale calibration.
landing.step2Desc: Assume an A-pose at a frontal zero-degree angle, then turn ninety degrees sideways following on-screen cues.
landing.step3Desc: Instantly view seven anatomical measurements, an interactive 3D mannequin, and tailored brand recommendations.
landing.privacyDesc: Image processing executes exclusively in your browser volatile memory. Once geometric extraction finishes, raw frames are destroyed and never stored anywhere.
landing.privacyPoint1: No image storage on remote servers or persistent databases.
landing.privacyPoint2: Only anonymous numeric dimensional data is preserved.
landing.studioDesc: Connect seamlessly with clients via secure access tokens, establish proprietary size specifications, and configure style-based ease allowances.

scan.title: Anthropometric Scan Pipeline
scan.frontGuide: Stand straight in an A-pose with arms flared at approximately thirty-five degrees.
scan.sideGuide: Rotate ninety degrees sideways and maintain an upright posture.
scan.memoryCleared: Raw camera frames cleared from browser RAM
